chunks: And in the narration of ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Jābir, who attributed it upward:

That Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was brought al-Najāshī al-Ḥārithī, the poet, who had drunk wine in the month of Ramaḍān. So he struck him with eighty lashes, then detained him for a night. Then he called for him the next day and struck him with twenty lashes. He said, "O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, you struck me with eighty lashes for drinking wine, so what are these twenty?" He said, "This is for your audacity in drinking wine in the month of Ramaḍān."

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْخَمْرَ: wine or intoxicating drink, the prohibited substance involved in the offense
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty lashes, the legal punishment applied for drinking wine
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, whose sanctity made the offense more severe
key_terms.عِشْرِينَ: twenty additional lashes imposed beyond the primary punishment
key_terms.لِجُرْأَتِكَ: for your audacity, indicating bold violation of sacred limits

ai.seo_question: Why did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام add extra lashes for drinking wine in Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام punished a man for drinking wine during the month of Ramaḍān. The narration distinguishes between the fixed legal punishment for drinking wine and an additional punishment due to the violation of the sanctity of Ramaḍān.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5089 - In the narration of Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who attributed it to the Prophet:

Commander of the Faithful (as) was presented with Al-Najashi Al-Harithiyy, the poet, who had consumed alcohol during the month of Ramadan.
Imam (as) flogged him eighty lashes, then imprisoned him for a night.
The next day, Imam (as) summoned him and flogged him with twenty more lashes.
Al-Najashi said: "O' Commander of the Faithful (as), you already flogged me eighty lashes for drinking alcohol. What are these additional twenty for?"
Imam (as) replied: "These are for your audacity in drinking alcohol during the month of Ramadan."
